
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(yaml)
library(htmltools)

data <- read_yaml("presentations.yml")

slides_svg <- '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M2 3h12v8H2V3zm1 1v6h10V4H3zm4 8h2v1h3v1H4v-1h3v-1z"/></svg>'

esc <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) "" else htmlEscape(x)

render_card <- function(item) {
  tag <- if (!is.null(item$url))
    sprintf('<a href="%s" class="tag" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s slides</a>',
            item$url, slides_svg) else ""

  authors <- if (!is.null(item$authors))
    sprintf('<div class="authors">with %s</div>', esc(item$authors)) else ""

  parts <- c()
  if (!is.null(item$venue))    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<span>%s</span>', esc(item$venue)))
  if (!is.null(item$location)) parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<span>%s</span>', esc(item$location)))
  if (!is.null(item$date))     parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<span>%s</span>', esc(item$date)))
  meta <- paste(parts, collapse = '<span class="sep">·</span>')

  sprintf(
    '<div class="card"><div class="card-title">%s %s</div>%s<div class="card-meta">%s</div></div>',
    esc(item$title), tag, authors, meta
  )
}

render_section <- function(items) {
  if (length(items) == 0) return(invisible())
  years <- sapply(items, function(x) x$year)
  ord <- order(years, decreasing = TRUE)
  items <- items[ord]; years <- years[ord]

  out <- c()
  for (y in unique(years)) {
    out <- c(out, sprintf('<div class="year-header">%d</div>', y))
    for (it in items[years == y]) out <- c(out, render_card(it))
  }
  cat(paste(out, collapse = "\n"))
}
```
